description.narrative: (Philippines): The U.S. government continues to provide significant development assistance in Mindanao province to reinforce the Philippine government's actions to secure lasting peace and shared economic growth. USAID, through Logistics Services in Mindanao, will support U.S. government project implementation in high-risk security areas by providing logistical, coordination, and security services that are closely coordinated with the U.S. Embassy Regional Security Office. FY 2022 funds will deliver the following services: arranging appropriate security for visits; logistical support for meetings with key actors, transportation, and lodging arrangements; and facilitating workshops. The activity manages a fleet of armored vehicles that support USAID's monitoring visits and disseminates information regarding the security situation in Mindanao. USAID's work benefits the broader U.S. Embassy community through facilitating travel to Mindanao.
